incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 - Redwood API (text generation) error spike in us-west1. Error rate >50% for last 2m. Primary oncall: Marcus L. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2039012345
Marcus L: Got it, looking now. Triage in progress.
Marcus L: initial check - manager nodes showing 5xx from worker pool (gpu-pool-03).
Marcus L: Can someone grab secondary? I'm mid-commute, might be slow to access terminals.
Priya S: I can take secondary. Jumping into a screen share, join if needed.
Marcus L: Thanks @Priya S. Quick customer impact note: some hosted API requests getting 500s, customers with reserved Dedicated should be unaffected, but hosted traffic is hit.
Ava R: FYI finance reported a spike in error-related billing disputes in the last hour. We should ping CS after mitigation.
Priya S: On it. Running the usual healthchecks: 
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.com/models/llama/v1/generate
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=gpu-pool-03
```
Priya S: Pods are crashlooping on node gpu-03-2, kernel OOM noticed in logs. Suspect recent rollout with larger batch size.
Omar K: I can spin up a hotfix pool and route traffic. Starting a small dedicated fallback pool (gpu-pool-03-fallback). ETA ~4m.
Marcus L: Thx Omar. If fallback works, we should switch traffic and scale down failing pool. Keep canary at 10% first.
Priya S: Found rollout config change in last deploy: `inference.batch.max_tokens` set to 2048 (previously 1024). That explains OOM trend.
Priya S: Rollback plan: set batch max_tokens back to 1024 and restart rollout for gpu-pool-03. Runbook ref: https://docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/oom-gpu-pool (see steps 2-4).
Marcus L: Given I'm remote, can you do the config rollback and restart, @Priya S? I'll monitor logs and customer impact.
Priya S: Will do. Applying rollback now. Command: 
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-service INFERENCE_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=1024 --record
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-service -n inference
```
incident-bot: Action log: rollback env var change applied by Priya S at 2039012460.
Priya S: Rollout started, pod restarts showing healthy within 90s for two pods.
Omar K: Fallback pool healthy, routing switched to fallback canary 10% -> success. No errors seen there.
Marcus L: Error rate dropping from 52% -> 8% in last minute. Good sign.
Ava R: I'll prepare a short customer message for CS and Legal. Draft: "We've identified a transient config rollback issue impacting hosted text generation in us-west1. Most traffic is back; we're monitoring."
Priya S: Rolling out full traffic shift to fallback while failing pool finishes restart.
Marcus L: Quick on-call handoff note: I'm primary until 12:30 UTC but had an unexpected family emergency earlier which caused a short coverage gap. Thanks to @Priya S and @Omar K for last-minute fill. Please update rotation board if you swapped.
SRE Ops: Noted. Please add a post-incident note to rotation log: https://internal.redwood/ops/rotation (include short description of gap and swap).
Priya S: Postmortem pointers: check deploy pipeline gate that allowed batch param change without perf regression tag. Adding eval for large-batch tests.
Marcus L: All right, error rate stable ~<2%. I'll stay on-call until 12:30 UTC and hand off to on-call schedule if stable at 12:15. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Priya S: Closing bridge in 10m unless we see regression. Marking this as mitigated for now.
incident-bot: Incident P1 mitigated at 2039012680. Please open a postmortem if customer impact > 5 minutes or billing disputes escalate."
